_doc: Every confirmed carrier of the 'Will of D.' in canon. The D. is a hereditary letter in the names of certain key figures — its meaning is the central mystery of One Piece. This page surfaces every D. carrier alongside the canon hints about what the D. signifies.

carriers.name: Monkey D. Luffy
carriers.notes: Protagonist. Awakened the Hito Hito no Mi Model: Nika.

carriers.name: Monkey D. Garp
carriers.notes: Vice Admiral. Cornered Roger. Luffy's grandfather.

carriers.name: Monkey D. Dragon
carriers.notes: Leader of the Revolutionary Army. Luffy's father. Origin unrevealed.

carriers.name: Portgas D. Ace
carriers.notes: Born Gol D. Ace; took mother's surname Portgas. Killed at Marineford.

carriers.name: Portgas D. Rouge
carriers.notes: Ace's mother. Held her pregnancy 20 months by sheer will to protect Ace.

carriers.name: Gol D. Roger
carriers.notes: First and only Pirate King. Reached Laugh Tale. Executed at Loguetown.

carriers.name: Marshall D. Teach
carriers.notes: Yonko. Holds two Devil Fruits (Yami Yami + Gura Gura). Theorised to be more than one person.

carriers.name: Trafalgar D. Water Law
carriers.notes: Worst Generation Supernova. Ope Ope no Mi user. Survived the Amber Lead disease at Flevance.

carriers.name: Jaguar D. Saul
carriers.notes: Former Vice Admiral. Saved baby Robin from the Buster Call on Ohara. Survived Aokiji's freeze — revealed alive on Elbaph.

carriers.name: Rocks D. Xebec
carriers.notes: Captain of the Rocks Pirates (Whitebeard, Big Mom, Kaidou, Shiki). Killed at God Valley by Roger + Garp.

_canon_hints: Whitebeard, dying at Marineford: 'One Piece is real.' The implication is that the D. carriers are the ones destined to inherit Roger's will.
The Five Elders refer to the D. as a 'natural enemy of the gods' — implying it stands against the Tenryubito and the World Government.
Roger and Whitebeard both said the D. carriers will start a great war that will engulf the world.
The 'Will of D.' is hereditary — passed down through the D. clan from generation to generation.

Common reading of the D.: 'Doom' (death-bringers to the Celestial Dragons), 'Dawn' (those who herald a new age — fitting Luffy as the Sun God), or simply the family marker of the lost Ancient Kingdom's lineage.
_speculation: Imu — long theorised to bear the D. (Nerona D. Imu). Family name 'Nerona' is canon, the D. status is fan-deduction from D-clan opposition to the World Government. Not yet confirmed.
Loki and Harald (Elbaph) — Sun God / Joy Boy connections in the Elbaph arc have prompted D. theories. Not yet confirmed.
Yamato — sometimes theorised to be a hidden D. via Kaidou's lineage. Not confirmed.
Shanks — fan theory based on his secrecy and alignment with Joy Boy. Not confirmed.
